name: raddebugger
description: A native, user-mode, multi-process, graphical debugger.
one_liner: A free, fast visual debugger for Windows programs, built by Epic Games as an alternative to the built-in debugger in Visual Studio.
buyer: A game studio's or systems-software company's build/tools engineer who needs faster link times and debugging on very large Windows C++ codebases.
business_use_cases: A large game studio adopts the included RAD Linker to cut multi-gigabyte debug-info link times on massive codebases, saving engineer waiting time.
A tools team builds internal training or onboarding docs around it to replace a slower commercial debugger license.
A systems-software contractor offers 'build pipeline speedup' consulting to studios, using this linker/debugger as part of the fix.

money_ideas.idea: Offer build-pipeline optimization consulting to game/C++ studios, using this tool as part of the deliverable.

steal_this: This is a pure developer infrastructure tool with no realistic standalone product play; honest take — skip building a business directly on this one, but keep it in your back pocket as a consulting credibility signal if you do build-tooling work.
